Blink2test.code
  git show 073dda5:tests/Blink2test.code
  last unfixed dump of the current tests/Blink2test.Mod source
  (counter := 0; maxIterations := 5). Earlier f3dd680 Blink2.Mod used

Blink2hw.Mod is not in this set: its delay constant changed after the
unfixed-dump era (2^24 -> 262144) so a bit-for-bit match is not expected.
